$comment: PREPARED TEMPLATE — NOT AUTHORITY. Every property is derived from the effective act/clause named in its 'source' annotation and creates no requirement beyond it. Gate 4 remains AUTHORIZED — NOT STARTED; QE 0/11; P-1 NOT EXECUTED. This schema expresses a CAP-02 Gate 4 QE run-evidence manifest; it executes nothing and accepts nothing.
description: CAP-02 Gate 4 QE run-evidence manifest template. Deposit location and artifact rules: effective Gate 4 act Q8 (IPD blob 66b56fd1...).

evidence_deposit.description: Deposit identity and integrity. IPD-side deposit per Gate 4 Q8; raw capture outside every worktree per H-12 R5 act section 2 item 9.

corrections_are_new_files.description: Immutability: artifacts written once, never edited; corrections are new files with recorded reason.
corrections_are_new_files.source: Gate 4 act Q8 immutability; Gate 4 act section 10 rule 1

deposit_path.description: IPD evidence/cross-repository/cap02_gate4_qe_<YYYY-MM-DD>_<run-id>/ (IPD-side deposit; IRR registration requires a separate IRR act).

every_attempt_preserved.description: Every attempt preserved, including invalidated ones; deleting an attempt is prohibited.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of this manifest file's actual bytes; each artifact SHA-256 recorded in a manifest that is itself hashed.

raw_capture_outside_worktrees.description: All raw logs, store files, IPC state and transcripts written outside every Git worktree during capture.
raw_capture_outside_worktrees.source: H-12 R5 adoption act section 2 item 9; host readiness packet section 6 item 7

remote_readback.description: Merge, green CI, remote blob read-back, independent second read-back with byte comparison; digests reproduced from a fresh clone.
remote_readback.source: Gate 4 act Q8 publication and read-back

h12.description: Adopted H-12 baseline for the run. R5 adopted in the governing IRR locus; IPD mirror receipt published.

adoption_act.description: Distinct PA adoption act; candidate validation alone never adopts.
adoption_act.source: Gate 4 act Q7; H-12 R5 adoption act IIPS-V3-CAP03-G4-H12-R5-PA-ADOPTION-ACT-2026-10-25-01

amended_s8_supplement_blob.description: Bound amended-section-8 supplemental inventory: 7/7 post-G3 CAP-02 entries (S-1..S-7) + 11 companion guards.
amended_s8_supplement_blob.source: H-12 R5 adoption act section 2 item 8; blob 6c777de6f36bfd06ff89373540d755cc367744f2

amended_s8_supplement_sha256.description: Raw SHA-256 of the supplemental inventory bytes.
amended_s8_supplement_sha256.source: H-12 R5 adoption act section 2 item 8

before_after_equal.description: Adopted H-12 digest set recorded at run start AND run end; any drift invalidates the run.
before_after_equal.source: Gate 4 act Q7 validation rules; Gate 4 act section 3.2 item 3; D-GC-H H-12

core_entries.description: G4-AMEND-01 Alternative A: 32 mandatory IPD paths + 24 IRR paths = 56 core entries, all PRESENT.
core_entries.source: G4-AMEND-01 Alternative A (IPD blob 21a0f9eb6cd7b1bbc4849d6dfd26c6c8025d60b8); H-12 R5 adoption act section 2 item 1

manifest_blob.description: Adopted primary manifest Git blob SHA-1.
manifest_blob.source: H-12 R5 adoption act header; blob f4649e36a81c7013287810cd3202b99586dbd951

manifest_sha256.description: Raw SHA-256 of the adopted manifest bytes.

h12.source: H-12 R5 adoption act (IRR PR #279 merge ae82be85...; receipt PR #280; IPD mirror PR #94)

host.description: Designated target host identity. No substitute host, platform, operator or runtime is qualifying.

account_sid.description: Current account SID recorded from the host.

edition.description: Windows edition as reported on the host.
edition.source: Gate 4 act section 12; host readiness packet PF-02

hostname.source: Gate 4 act section 12; Gate A-prime successor act section 8 (D-A-prime-2); host readiness packet PF-01

non_elevated.description: Operator account is non-elevated; PF-03 administrator-role check returns False.
non_elevated.source: Gate 4 act section 12; host readiness packet PF-03

operator.description: Only QE executor under the effective Gate 4 act.
operator.source: Gate 4 act section 12; host readiness packet header

platform.description: Node process.platform as reported on the host.
platform.source: Gate 4 act section 12; host readiness packet PF-04

non_grants_acknowledged.description: Run record restates that it grants no acceptance, admission, write authorization, fence lift, durable claim or production eligibility.
non_grants_acknowledged.source: Gate 4 act section 16; Gate A-prime successor act section 9; H-12 R5 adoption act section 7.1

p1_provisioning.description: Single bounded P-1 execution. Strictly after S2 passes and before S3. Consumed once whether it succeeds or fails.

command.description: Verbatim single invocation: --mode=execute --act-id <ID> --store <absolute path> --principal-label <v> --tenant-id <v> --canonical-owner-id <v> --actor <label>. Values on the command line, never environment variables.
command.source: Gate A-prime successor act section 8 step 3; section 5.3

exit_code.description: Exact exit code of the single invocation.

ordering.description: P-1 strictly after S2 passes and before S3; single-use grant consumed once.
ordering.source: H-12 R5 adoption act section 7.2; DQ-4 criterion 7; Gate A-prime successor act section 9

pre_state.description: Pre-run proof the store file did not exist (Test-Path False verbatim); read-only --mode=validate showing 0 bindings / 0 memberships; zero portfolio rows. Any pre-existing binding/membership row in any state means the act does not apply.
pre_state.source: Gate A-prime successor act section 8 steps 1-2

single_use_consumed.description: Authority consumed on completion whether the act succeeds or fails; any re-attempt requires a fresh rendering.

status.description: NOT EXECUTED until the single host execution occurs; then FAILED / ROLLED BACK or the V-A2 receipt.

store_path.description: Absolute path outside every Git worktree; local fixed NTFS; not synchronized; operator-writable without elevation; file must not pre-exist. Selected at execution time; recorded verbatim (operator path, not a secret).
store_path.source: Gate A-prime successor act section 8 step 1 (P-1 rule); Gate 4 act Q8 sensitivity

store_sha256_after.description: Store SHA-256 + size recorded after commit.
store_sha256_after.source: Gate A-prime successor act section 8 step 3

v_a2.description: Read-only validation report V-A2-1..V-A2-8 from --mode=validate with the same arguments.

V-A2-1_schema_ledger.description: Pass: _migration_ledger holds 001-004 with computed checksums; schema 004; migration 001 blob f594a182 unchanged.

V-A2-2_binding_cardinality.description: Pass: exactly one row ACTIVE, revoked_at NULL, binding_id = deterministic id (c5808abaffd072d6401ce63ad86c6ac0).
V-A2-2_binding_cardinality.source: Gate A-prime successor act section 6; S1 determination section 3

V-A2-3_membership_cardinality.description: Pass: exactly one row ACTIVE attached to the binding; tenant_id/canonical_owner_id equal the act values.
V-A2-3_membership_cardinality.source: Gate A-prime successor act section 6; S1 determination section 3

V-A2-4_no_other_rows.description: Pass: portfolios, revisions, holdings, contributions all 0.

V-A2-5_audit.description: Pass: exactly one hash-chained audit_events row, event_type local_principal_binding.provisioned, subject binding label, detail owner pair; chain verifies.

V-A2-6_resolution.description: Pass: resolveActiveBinding returns exactly the provisioned context; threw BindingAbsentError before.

V-A2-7_refusal_preservation.description: Pass: IPC still WRITE_NOT_AUTHORIZED before mutation; evaluatePortSaveGuard still hard-false.

V-A2-8_consumption.description: Pass: second invocation refused with zero change; act recorded consumed (mandated idempotence check, not a retry).
V-A2-8_consumption.source: Gate A-prime successor act section 6; host readiness packet section 4 step 11

v_a2.source: Gate A-prime successor act section 6 (IPD blob 528de6aeddbc8e5f3191be8792f3937d77de4037)

p1_provisioning.source: Gate A-prime successor act sections 6, 8, 8.1, 8.2, 9 (IPD blob 528de6aeddbc8e5f3191be8792f3937d77de4037)

pins.description: Designated QE coordinates. A pin is a named commit, not 'current main'; any non-documentary drift is a stop for explicit PA re-designation, never a silent re-pin.

ipd_commit.source: H-12 R5 adoption act section 2 item 1; DQ-4 freeze manifest section 1

ipd_tree.description: Root tree of the IPD QE coordinate.
ipd_tree.source: H-12 R5 adoption act section 2 item 1

irr_commit.source: H-12 R5 adoption act section 2 item 1; DQ-4 freeze manifest section 1

irr_tree.description: Root tree of the IRR QE consumer coordinate.
irr_tree.source: H-12 R5 adoption act section 2 item 1

pins.source: Gate 4 act section 3.2 commit rule; H-12 R5 adoption act section 3

qe.description: QE-1..QE-11 dispositions. Status vocabulary is exhaustive: PASS / FAIL / INCONCLUSIVE / NOT EXECUTED - <reason> / INVALID. No sixth class, no 'pass with caveats'. A limitation finding is never PASS. Component evidence is never PASS for a full-path criterion.

acceptance_separate.description: True where a separate acceptance act is additionally required (QE-11 Gate C subset; then Gate 4 result acceptance for all).
acceptance_separate.source: Gate 4 act section 7 grant boundaries; Gate E section 4

artifacts.description: Raw artifact paths for this item: command, exit code, UTC start/end, host identity, Node version, commit/tree, row counts, transcripts, manifests, execution record.

evidence_ceiling.description: Highest honest classification under current authority: full-path candidate / component-level / limitation finding.
evidence_ceiling.source: Gate 4 act section 5 adopted rules; host readiness packet section 5

execution_location.description: Native target host only. POSIX/CI/fixture evidence is non-qualifying.
execution_location.source: Gate E section 4; D-GC-F; Gate 4 act section 3.2

pass_conditions.description: Observable conditions from the governing record. PASS additionally requires an executed scenario at the designated commit on the designated host, with raw evidence, in the tier that can reach it.
pass_conditions.source: Governing record per item; Gate 4 act section 5 adopted rule 2

requirement.description: Verbatim governing requirement (abridged pointer; full text in the cited record).
requirement.source: Gate E write policy rev 1 section 4 (IPD blob 4a9501bffb49abbbc0ba5b5c4f81d2841812913e) with L-IPC-1 section 10 / D-GC / G2-D3 mappings

tiers.description: T1 real endpoint with all fences on; T2 real store on disposable copies; T3 session-port identity boundary. Every artifact carries a per-scenario tier label.

^QE-(1[01]|[1-9])$.source: Gate E section 4 (per-item requirement); Gate 4 act sections 5, 7, 10 (tiers, grant, classes)

qe.source: Gate E section 4; Gate 4 act sections 5, 7, 10; host readiness packet section 5

record_id.description: Run-evidence manifest record identifier (assigned at run publication; census-checked).

run_id.description: Run identifier; a repeated attempt gets a new run ID.
run_id.source: Gate 4 act section 10 rule 1; D-GC H-7 run-id rule via proposal section 5.2(7)

runtime.description: Runtime preflight. Historical v24.14.0 violates the required major and is not preflight evidence. No runtime installation or switch is authorized.

node_range.description: Required Node major 22 at or above 22.13.0.
node_range.source: Gate 4 act section 12; Gate 3 act sections 8.1/8.3; host readiness packet PF-04

sqlite_flag_free.description: node:sqlite loads and operates without experimental flags or warnings.
sqlite_flag_free.source: Gate 4 act section 12; host readiness packet PF-05

s1_identity_values.description: S1 identity values are determined and bound; they are inputs to P-1, not P-1 evidence.

determination.description: Separate PA identity-value determination discharging successor act section 4.
determination.source: S1 determination header; IPD PR #80 merge d8568b0e...; receipt PR #81

s2_host_verification.description: S2 canonical native-Windows host verification: 5 ordered commands at the exact IPD pin. Requires no store path, no PF-15 designation, and consumes no P-1 grant. Any non-zero exit stops the sequence.

build_dist_count.description: Verified dist/** file count from a clean host build.
build_dist_count.source: H-12 R5 adoption act section 2 item 9; readiness packet section 6 item 2; S2 blocker section 2

commands.description: Ordered S2 commands with per-command exit code, UTC start/end, stdout/stderr paths. Guarded npm test count is authoritative; direct TAP is supplemental only.
commands.source: Host readiness packet section 3; S2 blocker record sections 2-3

status.source: S2 blocker record section 2 disposition vocabulary

items.source: Host readiness packet section 3; S2 blocker record section 2

expected_dist_count.description: Expected clean-build dist/** count; a different count is a stop for PA re-designation, never silently accepted.
expected_dist_count.source: Host readiness packet section 6 item 2; H-12 R5 adoption act section 2 item 9

status.description: NOT EXECUTED until all five host commands run in order with raw capture outside every worktree.

s2_host_verification.source: Host readiness packet section 3; H-12 R5 adoption act section 7.2

s3_preflight.description: S3 host/runtime preflight. Strictly after S2 passes and the single P-1 executes; requires PF-15 endpoint/local-state designation. Any failure or ambiguity stops before QE.

pf03_non_elevated.description: Administrator-role check False; account SID recorded.

pf05_sqlite.description: node:sqlite loads without experimental flag; output recorded.

pf06_no_runtime_switch.description: Same designated runtime; no install or switch evidence.

pf07_ipd_clean_tree.description: IPD commit/tree exactly the designated pin; no tracked changes.

pf08_irr_clean_tree.description: IRR commit/tree exactly the designated consumer pin; no tracked changes.

pf10_no_enabling_flags.description: IIPS_G3_IPC_BINDING_PROVISIONED, IIPS_ENABLE_WRITES, IIPS_G3_ENABLE_WRITES, GATE_E_OVERRIDE all absent.

pf11_store_syntax.description: Store path absolute, outside every worktree, local fixed NTFS, not synchronized, operator-writable without elevation.

pf12_store_state.description: Store existence state recorded verbatim as applicable to the ordered step (absent before P-1; provisioned store verified after).
pf12_store_state.source: Host readiness packet PF-12; Gate A-prime successor act section 8

pf13_parent_location.description: Parent exists, local fixed NTFS, not cloud-synced or network.

pf14_evidence_root.description: Evidence root designated outside every worktree; absolute, writable, not the store path, not synchronized.

pf15_endpoint_state.description: PA-designated IPC endpoint / local-state directory. NOT DESIGNATED today; S3 and QE stop here until named.
pf15_endpoint_state.source: Host readiness packet PF-15; H-12 R5 adoption act section 7.2

pf16_authority_text.description: Rendered acts confirmed: exact Act IDs, pins, store, order, adoption digest; no placeholder accepted.

pf17_p1_unspent.description: P-1 execution unspent per the PA consumption register; any prior attempt or failure requires a fresh act.
pf17_p1_unspent.source: Host readiness packet PF-17; Gate A-prime successor act section 9

status.description: NOT REACHED until S2 passes, the single P-1 executes, and PF-15 is designated.
status.source: S2 blocker records section 4; H-12 R5 adoption act section 7.2

s3_preflight.source: Host readiness packet section 2 (IPD blob 9d9c5970f66b1c901a2b5d28c02e8c9562078cf2); H-12 R5 adoption act section 7.2

schema_id.description: This template's own identifier. Template status only; not an effective-act ID.
schema_id.source: This prepared record; census-checked at publication

sequencing.description: Effective ordered sequence. Vocabulary note: Gate 4 act section 6 labels provisioning S1 and Limb A S2; the current operational sequence below (S2 host verification, then single P-1, then S3 preflight, then QE) follows the later effective sequencing in the H-12 R5 adoption act and DQ-4 criterion 7.
sequencing.source: H-12 R5 adoption act section 7.2; DQ-4 freeze manifest criterion 7; Gate 4 act section 6 as amended by later sequencing

u4_acceptance.description: U4 result acceptance is a separate PA act after the run; it is never part of a run record. No run, commit, CI result or merged PR is acceptance.
u4_acceptance.source: Gate 4 act sections 6 (S6), 14; Gate E W-1(3)

source: Gate 4 act Q8/Q10/Q11/Q12 evidence, failure, durability and executor rules (IPD blob 66b56fd1584890525a7250aadd7da449def621e5); Gate A-prime successor act sections 6/8/9 (IPD blob 528de6aeddbc8e5f3191be8792f3937d77de4037)
